an4.125:1.3: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo mettāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati, tathā dutiyaṃ . . . tathā tatiyaṃ . . . tathā catutthiṃ, iti uddham adho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ mettāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena avyāpajjhena pharitvā viharati.
an4.125:1.4: So tad assādeti tan nikāmeti tena ca vittiṃ āpajjati,
an4.125:1.5: tattha ṭhito tadadhimutto tabbahulavihārī aparihīno kālaṃ kurumāno Brahmakāyikānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ uppajjati.
an4.125:1.9: Ayaṃ kho bhikkhave viseso ayaṃ adhippāyāso idaṃ nānākaraṇaṃ sutavato ariyasāvakassa assutavatā puthujjanena yadidaṃ gatiyā uppattiyā sati. 2.
an4.125:2.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave idh' ekacco puggalo karuṇāsahagatena cetasā . . . pe . . .
an4.125:2.3: upekhāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati, tathā dutiyaṃ tathā tatiyaṃ tathā catutthiṃ iti uddham adho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ upekhāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena avyāpajjhena pharitvā viharati.
an4.125:2.4: So tad assādeti tan nikāmeti tena ca vittiṃ āpajjati,
an4.125:2.5: tattha ṭhito tad-adhimutto tabbahulavihārī aparihīno kālaṃ kurumāno Ābhassarānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ uppajjati.
an4.125:2.6: Ābhassarānaṃ bhikkhave dve kappā āyuppamāṇaṃ . . . pe . . . Subhakiṇhānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ uppajjati.
an4.125:2.7: Subhakiṇhānaṃ bhikkhave devānaṃ cattāro kappā āyuppamāṇaṃ . . . pe . . . Vehapphalānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ uppajjāti.
an4.125:2.9: tattha puthujjano yāvatāyukaṃ ṭhatvā yāvatakaṃ tesaṃ devānaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ taṃ sabbaṃ khepetvā nirayam pi gacchati tiracchānayonim pi gacchati pittivisayam pi gacchati.
an4.125:2.10: Bhagavato pana sāvako tattha yāvatāyukaṃ thatvā yāvatakaṃ tesaṃ devānaṃ ayuppamāṇaṃ taṃ sabbaṃ khepetvā tasmiṃ yeva bhave parinibbāyati.
an4.125:2.11: Ayaṃ kho bhikkhave viseso ayaṃ adhippāyāso idaṃ nānākaraṇaṃ sutavato ariyasāvakassa assutavatā puthujjanena yadidaṃ gatiyā uppattiyā sati.
an4.125:2.12: Ime kho bhikkhave cattāro puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmin ti. 126. 1.
